name: Pennsylvania American Water
why: ~700K customers; largest American Water subsidiary (largest U.S. investor-owned water utility). NJ American Water shares the same amwater.com billing site, so only PA is picked.

name: NYC Department of Environmental Protection (NYC Water Board)
why: ~836K accounts; water/sewer for all five NYC boroughs.

name: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP)
why: ~680K water accounts; largest U.S. municipal utility, nationally recognized.

name: Miami-Dade Water and Sewer Department (WASD)
why: ~560K accounts serving ~2.4M people in Miami-Dade County.

name: Philadelphia Water Revenue Bureau (Philadelphia Water Department)
why: ~524K accounts; city of Philadelphia water/sewer/stormwater.

name: California Water Service (Cal Water)
why: ~500K customers; largest investor-owned water utility in California.

name: WSSC Water
why: ~475K accounts; Montgomery and Prince George's Counties, MD (one of the largest U.S. water utilities).

name: Veolia Water (formerly SUEZ)
why: ~390K customers in NJ, NY, PA, DE, RI; national brand (Veolia North America).

name: Denver Water
why: ~350K accounts; Colorado's largest water utility.

name: Aqua Pennsylvania / Aqua New Jersey
why: ~322K customers; Essential Utilities' Aqua brand, a major national investor-owned water company.

name: Autoridad de Acueductos y Alcantarillados (AAA / PRASA)
why: ~1.25M accounts; water and sewer for about 97% of Puerto Rico, Mi Acueductos portal plus Pago Expreso.

name: City of Chicago Department of Finance - Utility Billing
why: ~527K accounts; unified water/sewer bill for Chicago (2.7M people), utilitybill.chicago.gov portal.

name: Cleveland Water
why: ~454K accounts; serves 1.3M people in Cleveland and suburbs, My Cleveland Water portal.

name: JEA
why: ~428K water accounts; Jacksonville's municipal utility (combined electric/water/sewer bill).

name: Baltimore City Department of Public Works - Water Billing
why: ~425K accounts; bills Baltimore City and Baltimore County water/sewer, Paymentus Customer Payment Portal.

name: East Bay Municipal Utility District (EBMUD)
why: ~400K accounts in Alameda and Contra Costa counties (Oakland, Berkeley), well-known California district.

name: Citizens Energy Group - Citizens Water
why: ~352K accounts; Indianapolis water/wastewater (and gas) under one My Account.

name: Metro Water Services (Nashville)
why: ~337K accounts; Nashville-Davidson County water and sewer, mwsonline portal.

name: Suffolk County Water Authority (SCWA)
why: ~336K accounts; one of the largest U.S. groundwater suppliers (Long Island), KUBRA portal.

name: Charlotte Water
why: ~324K accounts; largest NC water utility, new CLTWaterHub portal plus KUBRA EZ-PAY.
